items.summary: Maintain a bounded site-factory pipeline for gate03.com, therareunicorn.com, and findyourlostpets.com using existing readiness briefs only. Each packet remains evidence-only and must contain a site brief, reusable template, content seed, SEO baseline, analytics and affiliate readiness, compliance checklist, owner/legal/security/measurement gates, rollback plan, and launch disposition. Preserve unknown telemetry and do not deploy, change domains, spend, alter credentials or configuration, add tracking, monetize, or launch.

Strongest candidate is gate03.com based on the existing reported readiness brief. Its launch path remains blocked by the missing execution owner; no implementation or launch gate can advance until ownership is evidenced.
